scope.description: Local AppendFuture access contract in Raft.pipelineDecode for completed built-in pipeline futures. Measure call order with an observing forwarding wrapper; do not substitute a successful reply for a real failed RPC.
assumptions: The wrapper delegates all methods and values to the actual future and records method entry/return only.
An isolated decoder context is sufficient for this method-access contract; no election or application history is inferred.
excluded: Whether invalid response bytes cause an unsafe commit
A requirement to call Response after an error; the requirement is conditional on access

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: A forwarding future wrapper records only Error return and first Response invocation; it delegates original values and does not pre-call Error.
A pipeline proxy delivers that same wrapped real future to an isolated real decoder; transport producer output is otherwise unchanged.
The decoder receiver and followerReplication are minimally initialized; no leadership prefix is claimed. Empty requests exclude match-index and application effects.
Timeout is generated by actual InmemTransport; tool timeouts call t.Fatal and do not emit a completed comparison.
The permitted control uses a separate operation and future; it never supplies history for either decoder case.
boundaries: Whether invalid response bytes cause an unsafe commit
A requirement to call Response after an error; the requirement is conditional on access
Only the in-memory producer is executed; network producer support is sourced but not execution coverage.
A contract mismatch does not establish use of invalid successful support: the timeout response remains false and the successful reply comes from the actual follower.
The unbootstrapped follower and supplied term-1 request are an RPC prefix for this local interface check, not a proven election history.
Stronger consensus consequences need separate legal producer/fault/history evidence.
The harness does not establish the synthetic sender as a legally elected leader; this is excluded from the local claim.
The network transport and configuration transitions remain outside this execution.
Network pipeline branch is not executed.
No leader election prefix, log commitment or application consequence is exercised.
